shared_elements: rectangular framed panel with carved relief content
rows of small repeated units (lines of signs in A; rows of beading/curls in B)
justification: A shows only a rectangular panel filled with horizontal lines of small repeated incised signs, with no figures or objects, while B shows a single large bearded human head and shoulder in profile with a tall headdress, earring, and beaded garment bands. The only correspondence is the very generic notion of a rectangular relief field containing rows of small repeated units, which any carving tradition could produce independently; there is no shared figural motif or relationship at all.
